test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following fugure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c75dea59bef56e456bf7f0144e3ced1702f680a9c0e6811102b5e72c7a9a285.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: The 'Triangle' are getting shaded in alternate images and getting rotated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd6654299c5771011b71af8a8b190e74ddf4642bf0df21b81de5743fdcf40049.png] 

Step II: The 'Diamond' are getting rotated one place in each box.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88c924de800607634f30faa53332e5d47fb79534368a2ff660b8eece1e782dee.png] 

Step III: The 'Arrow' are getting rotated one place in each box.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13ac1774e05e025d318305aa237b18dda2666bdaae5ac5faa375444d4c8a69d2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
